newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Somague rises on H1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Somague rises on H1 profit.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese construction holding Somague SGPS rose on Lisbon bourse, encouraged by its first half profit results, dealers said.
"The results were very good," said one operator. "I think that today the share could surpass the previous high for the year (1,190 escudos)."
Yesterday Somague posted a first half consolidated net profit of 0.467 billion escudos, up from 0.129 billion in the same year-ago period.
Somague stood at 1,165 escudos, up 11, in volume of 67,500 shares at 0944 GMT.
